Queue (sidebar): postQueue.ts orders each brand's finished videos per social, and planSchedule puts them into the next free posting time (PostingSettings times, at most DAILY_LIMIT 3 a day per account, at most HORIZON_DAYS 21 ahead so Ayrshare's uploads stay). useAyrshare's auto-scheduler sends one at a time while the app is open; Ayrshare posts them on time. Video.scheduled holds each post's Ayrshare id and state; applyHistory (ayrsharePosting.ts) reads Ayrshare's history back as the truth.
